system.implants: Basic Biomods, Basic Mesh Inserts, Cortical Stack, Prehensile Feet
system.advantages: +5 INT, +10 SOM, +5 to one other aptitude of the player's choice
system.description:
Neo-gorillas were uplifted in the same manner as the other neo-hominids and share the same characteristics, though they are not quite as adept at climbing. They stand roughly as tall as humans, though they have stronger and larger frames.

Notes: Non-Human Biochemistry trait

Source: Eclipse Phase Morph Recognition Guide, p. 62.
